label: 20f9a45ee
environment: Rust 20 min and C 5 min per scenario, one at a time, full scale · Redis 8.6.2 · Apple M-series, 11 cores, 36 GB

notes.html: Re-soaked on d070f1f9b, main after 19 more PRs incl. #3511, #3578, #3856, #3035, #3469 (was 77ab63f48). Outside the blocked areas, Rust is production-grade: no crash, panic or hang in 12 full-scale soaks, and the C baseline, release v4.22.4, did not crash either (the earlier local July master build crashed twice, in s03 and s11; both are gone in the release). Against v4.22.4, C still has 5 open problems of its own (C4–C7, C10). Snapshot isolation, durability across 8 kill/restart cycles, replication, and multi-tenant churn were all exact. Re-soak on main d070f1f9b (compared with 77ab63f48), all 12 scenarios on a quiet machine; runs that overlapped outside load above 20 were discarded and repeated. No finding changed state: F3 (range index loses numeric 0: s03, s10), F9 (index built under writes loses entries: s10), R1 (s12 still at ~0.45× C write throughput; fix PR #3889 still open) and F10 (#3886, upstream HNSW, C too) still block; F7 is unchanged by #3511 (s05 keeps 210 MB of used_memory after every graph is deleted). The s03 late ingest stall seen on 77ab63f48 did not recur (ingest p99 22 → 29 ms early to late), so s03 recovers 53.5 → 58.6. Watch: p99 of light operations rose 1.25–2× in s05, s08 and s09 (e.g. replica 1-hop read 2.2 → 4.3 ms, ledger write 2.7 → 5.0 ms, durability lookups 6 → 8.6 ms), taking p99 vs C to 2.1× in s05, 1.72× in s09 and 1.1× in s08; this is unconfirmed (single runs) and needs an A/B of 77ab63f48 vs d070f1f9b, with #3469 (GraphBLAS 10.5.3) and #3578 (write retry) the first suspects. An s05 run on d070f1f9b lost its server to an external SIGKILL with no crash log; the repeat ran clean. Caveats: the C baseline (release v4.22.4) is built without OpenMP, so vs-C performance ratios favour Rust; after a /tmp cleanup on 2026-11-23 the scenario scripts were rebuilt from transcripts (s06 verified byte-identical to the surviving original).

caveats: One macOS machine, shared at times with other jobs, so absolute latencies are indicative and the Rust/C ratios are the signal. The C baseline is release v4.22.4 (falkordb-macos-arm64v8.so from the GitHub release, module ver 42204) for all 12 scenarios; the earlier runs on a local July master build are kept as @jul-master. C runs are 5 min, so slow drift is only measured on Rust.
